hint_tap: Tap where to go or what to use

regulars_hint: Sell regulars what they're looking for to earn hearts. Each heart unlocks a story and a reward.
regular_locked: Earn more hearts to hear this
managers_desc: Their section restocks itself without boxes and sells for 10% more. You also earn 1 more hour while away.

tut_fillShelf: Got the goods! Tap the shelf for that product to stock it.
tut_checkout: Customers are lining up. Tap the register to stand behind it and check out.
tut_collect: The money piles up next to the register. Walk close to collect it.
tut_build: Tap the hammer at the bottom right and place a shelf. Pick, position, then ✓!
intro_1:
Welcome, new manager!
You're taking over Grandma's little corner store.
intro_2:
Stock what customers want, check them out, and grow the store with what you earn.
Listen to your regulars' stories too.
intro_3:
Turn a tiny shop into the best store in town!
You can even open stores by the beach, downtown and in a snowy village.
b_piyak_desc: The cozy town where it all begins
b_beach_desc: A summer village that loves ice cream and watermelon
b_night_desc: A sparkling street where hot dogs and pizza fly off the shelves
b_snow_desc: A winter village craving warm coffee and cake
reg_mina_intro: A college student who buys donuts every exam week
reg_mina_h1: "You have donuts? Phew… I'm pulling an all-nighter tonight."
reg_mina_h3: "Exams are over! I told all my friends about this place."
reg_mina_h4: "Actually, I want to be a baker. Would you sell my donuts here someday?"
reg_mina_h5: "I got into baking school! It's thanks to you. Thank you so much!"
reg_jun_intro: An office worker who grabs a sandwich on the way to work
reg_jun_h1: "A sandwich is all I need for breakfast. Quick checkout, please?"
reg_jun_h2: "Stopping by here makes my day feel a little less busy."
reg_jun_h3: "I have a big presentation today… wish me luck!"
reg_jun_h4: "The presentation went great! I might get promoted."
reg_jun_h5: "I'm team leader now. I'll buy all our team snacks here!"
reg_sora_intro: A surfer who wants ice cream after riding the waves
reg_sora_h1: "Ice cream after surfing is the best!"
reg_sora_h2: "The waves were amazing today. Want to try surfing sometime?"
reg_sora_h3: "I signed up for a competition. I'm so nervous…"
reg_sora_h4: "I made it through the heats! Two ice creams today, right?"
reg_sora_h5: "I won! I'll use the prize money to start surf lessons for the village kids."
reg_taeo_intro: A fisherman who buys watermelon after the dawn catch
reg_taeo_h1: "Heh, after the sea breeze I always crave cold watermelon."
reg_taeo_h3: "This spot used to be a net shed. Time flies."
reg_taeo_h4: "Young folks like you are bringing the village back to life."
reg_taeo_h5: "The biggest fish I caught today is yours. Thanks for everything!"
reg_rin_intro: A night DJ who comes for pizza after the show
reg_rin_h1: "I'm starving after the show. You've got pizza, right?"
reg_rin_h2: "Who picks the music in here? Great taste!"
reg_rin_h3: "I'm making a new track. It's called 'Midnight Store'."
reg_rin_h4: "The track is out! The first beat is the sound of your door opening."
reg_rin_h5: "I drew this store on my first album cover. Is that okay?"
reg_dal_intro: An all-night taxi driver powered by hot dogs
reg_dal_h1: "Gotta have a hot dog to drive all night!"
reg_dal_h2: "When passengers ask where to get good snacks, I send them here."
reg_dal_h3: "Today I drove a lost kid all the way home."
reg_dal_h4: "My daughter's getting married next month. I'm all choked up."
reg_dal_h5: "I'd love to get the wedding favors here. Will you help?"
reg_yuki_intro: A ski instructor who warms up frozen hands here
reg_yuki_h1: "One warm coffee and my frozen hands thaw out."
reg_yuki_h2: "A little student made it down without falling for the first time today!"
reg_yuki_h3: "I actually came from another country. This is my second home."
reg_yuki_h4: "Seeing your store lights makes me feel safe even in a blizzard."
reg_yuki_h5: "I've decided to live here for good! Let's keep being friends."
reg_bom_intro: A sweet granddaughter who buys cake for every birthday
reg_bom_h1: "Grandma loves the cake from this store the most."
reg_bom_h2: "I saved up my allowance to buy it today!"
reg_bom_h3: "Grandma said to tell you thank you."
reg_bom_h4: "Grandma and I wrote you a letter. Please take it!"
reg_bom_h5: "Grandma's coming herself this birthday. Please celebrate with us!"
help_move_b: Tap where to go or what to use, and you'll walk there and do it. Drag with one finger to move the map, pinch with two to zoom. Prefer a joystick? Turn it on in Settings.
help_stock_b: Tap an empty shelf (red !) to grab that product from its box and fill the shelf. Each box holds 24 and runs down as you take from it. New boxes arrive empty, so order stock first. When a box is empty, tap it to reorder at wholesale price; it arrives in 15 seconds. Your staff can't stock from an empty box, so order ahead. You can also select a box in build mode to order before it runs out.
help_checkout_b: Tap the register to stand on the blue spot behind it and check out. Money you ring up piles up next to the register, so walk close to collect it. Hire a cashier and money comes straight in.
help_build_b: Tap the hammer at the bottom right to enter build mode. Pick something, drag or tap the preview into place, then press ✓. Tap a placed item to move, change product, rotate, level up or sell it.
help_customers_b: Customers get disappointed if what they want is missing or the line is too long. A higher rating and more shelves and decorations bring customers more often. Without a trash bin nearby they litter, so place bins.
help_staff_b: Cashiers run registers, stockers carry boxes to shelves, janitors clean trash. A section manager makes that section restock itself without boxes and sell for more. Staff are paid every minute.
help_levelup_b: Level up a shelf to hold more and sell for more. Level up a register to check out faster. In build mode, tap the fixture and press the ⬆ button.
help_regulars_b: Customers with a heart over their head are regulars. Sell them what they're looking for to earn hearts. Each heart unlocks a story and a reward. Read them again in the Regulars book.
help_branches_b: As you level up you can open new stores in Beach Village, Night Street and Snow Village. Money and level are shared, but each store grows on its own. Each town's featured products sell for 20% more.
help_goals_b: Complete the goal at the top left for a reward. Sometimes a rush of customers or VIP guests who pay double arrive. While the app is closed, cashiers and managers keep earning a little.
placed_hint: Placed! Tap a placed item to move or sell it
day_closed_hint: The store is closed. Build at your own pace, then open when you're ready
day_last_call: Last call! Here comes the rush
day_closing: Closing time! Serving the last customers
help_day_b: Open the doors and customers come for 3 minutes. 30 seconds before closing there's a rush, and when time is up you serve the last customers and close. The target is a bit above your recent average, so an ordinary day earns one star; do better for two or three, and more stars mean a bigger bonus. Finish the two tasks for extra rewards. At the end of the day you pay rent for your land and upkeep for your shelves. While the store is closed there are no customers, so take your time building.
rank_up: Your store moved up a rank!
rank_1_new: Weather forecasts begin! And surprises start during the day: shoplifters, lost kids and broken shelves. Your staff can't handle them, so it's up to you!
rank_2_new: A special day comes every 5 days. Angry customers start showing up too. Hurry over and calm them down!
rank_3_new: Delivery orders come in! Gather the items and bring them to the door.
rank_4_new: Neighborhood festivals join the special days! Big crowds and double rewards.
rank_5_new: VIPs visit twice as often. You run the best store in town!
help_rank_b: Your store ranks up at levels 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 (Corner Shop → Convenience Store → Big Convenience Store → Supermarket → Hypermarket → Department Store). Each rank brings 8% more customers and unlocks something new: weather, special days, surprises, deliveries, festivals and VIPs. The sign on the wall shows your current rank.
special_picnic_d: Groups of customers keep pouring in!
special_exam_d: Lots of students in a hurry.
special_festival_d: Huge crowds, and the star bonus is doubled!
help_weather_b: Once you're a Convenience Store, a weather forecast appears before you open. Ice cream and drinks sell well on hot days; cup ramyeon, buns and coffee on rainy or cold days, so adjust your shelves. From Big Convenience Store, a special day comes every 5 days (Picnic Day, Exam Week, and from Hypermarket, the Town Festival).
inc_thiefFlee: Shoplifter! Tap to chase them down!
inc_kidLost: A lost kid is crying. Go comfort them!
inc_kidFound: The kid found their mom! Reward: {n}
inc_orderIn: Ring ring! A delivery order came in
help_incident_b: From Convenience Store (level 5), surprises happen during the day, more often as your rank rises. Only you can handle them, not your staff. Tap a running shoplifter (red !) to chase and catch them; the fine is double what they took. Walk up to a crying kid (?) to help them find their mom. Stand next to a smoking broken shelf for a moment to fix it; customers can't buy from it while it's broken. From Big Convenience Store, angry customers (!!) appear; if you don't calm them down, your rating drops a lot. From Supermarket, delivery orders arrive.
dex_people_hint: New faces are recorded when they visit. Reward {r} at {n}!
dex_stamps_hint: Sell {n} of a product to earn its stamp and a reward (price × {n}).
help_dex_b: When a customer you've never seen visits, they're added to your collection and 'NEW!' pops up. Every 10th customer brings a reward. Sell 30 of a product to earn its stamp and a reward. Find it under 'Collection' in the menu or on the title screen.
story_hint: The story of Peep Town continues as your store grows and you open new neighborhoods. Tap a chapter you've seen to watch it again.
story_opening_0:
Well done, my new manager! Did you see the customers smile?
That's this store's real treasure.
story_opening_1:
I'm off to rest in the seaside town now.
Take good care of the store. I'll write to you!
story_opening_2:
Hmph, a tiny corner shop like this still exists?
Soon this whole town belongs to MegaMart!
story_opening_4:
Boss Kang, owner of MegaMart!
Just you wait, ha ha ha!
story_rival_0:
Boss! MegaMart just opened across the street!
It's huge!
story_rival_1:
A convenience store now? Cute.
MegaMart even stocks up according to the weather!
story_rival_2:
The weather...? Then we can check the forecast
and change our shelves too!
story_rival_3:
Always check the forecast before opening!
I'll tell you every day.
story_mayor_0:
Ahem, I'm the mayor of Peep Town.
Every five days there's something on: Picnic Day, Exam Week...
story_mayor_1:
MegaMart is too big to know this town.
I'd like your store to be our living room.
story_mayor_2:
But boss, there are more suspicious customers lately.
They grab things and just run out!
story_mayor_3:
Shoplifters? If we see one, we chase them down!
And let's always help lost kids.
story_beach_when: Open a store in Beach Village
story_beach_0:
You opened a store by the sea? That's my town!
Sora the surfer and Grandpa Taeo will be regulars.
story_beach_1:
So close to you, Grandma!
I'll visit often.
story_beach_2:
It's hot here most days.
Keep plenty of ice cream and watermelon in stock.
story_scheme_0:
The shoplifter we caught said...
someone paid them to mess up our store!
story_scheme_1:
Ahem, ahem! I know nothing about that!
Anyway, MegaMart does deliveries now!
story_scheme_2:
We can deliver too.
We know these alleys better than anyone!
story_scheme_3:
Ho ho, so the delivery orders will come to you now.
Just make sure they arrive on time.
story_night_when: Open a store on Night Street
story_night_0:
It's the Night Street store!
They say the lights never go out here.
story_night_1:
Even MegaMart closes at night...
What a stubborn kid.
story_night_2:
DJ Rin and Dal the taxi driver
are going to be our regulars!
story_festival_0:
This year's town festival will be held in front of your store!
The whole town will be there.
story_festival_1: A festival...? It's empty in front of MegaMart...
story_festival_2: Boss Kang looks a little lonely.
story_festival_3:
Let's run the festival together!
The more customers, the better.
story_snow_when: Open a store in Snow Village
story_snow_0:
All the way to the snow village!
It's cold there, so warm food is king.
story_snow_1: Let's stock lots of buns and coffee!
story_snow_2:
Yuki the ski instructor is waiting too!
Let's go.
story_finale_0:
My goodness, that little corner shop is a department store?
I came running the moment I got your letter!
story_finale_1:
...I lose. Now I see why everyone comes to your store.
They all leave smiling.
story_finale_2:
MegaMart is closing.
Could I... work here? I'm great at stocking shelves!
story_finale_3: Of course! You're part of our family from today.
story_finale_4:
This is the store's real treasure.
Keep up the good work, my manager!
story_finale_5:
The end... no, business goes on!
Peep Mart is open today too!
inc_brokeDown: A shelf broke down! Go stand next to it to fix it
inc_grumpyIn: An angry customer is making a scene! Go calm them down
inc_grumpyLeft: The customer stormed out... your rating dropped
dex_combos_hint: Place the shelves of three matching products close together (within two tiles) to make a set. Set shelves sell for {n}% more, and customers buy the whole set.
price_2_d: Pricey: price +20%, some customers walk away
price_3_d: Premium: price +40%, many customers walk away
help_combo_b: Put the shelves of three matching products (e.g. gimbap, rice cake skewers and cup ramyeon) within two tiles of each other to make a set: prices go up 20% and customers buy the whole set. See all sets under 'Sets' in your collection. Tap a shelf to change its price tag: higher prices earn more but some customers walk away, while low prices make customers happy. Very happy customers sometimes leave a tip on the floor; walk over and pick it up before the day ends!
inc_fever: Fever time! Prices x1.3 and a rush of customers for 15 seconds!
inc_inspectIn: The health inspector is here! Clean up trash and fill your shelves
inspect_forecast: 📋 Health inspection day! Clean up trash and keep your shelves full
help_fever_b: Keep checking out customers without long gaps (about twice the time between arrivals) to build a combo. At 15 combo it's fever time: for 15 seconds prices go up 1.3x and customers rush in. An upset customer breaks your combo. From Convenience Store, a health inspector visits every 7 days and tours your store. Trash, empty shelves and broken shelves lower the score. 80 or more earns a reward; under 50 means a fine.
reorder_busy: Already on the way, or the box is full
inc_boxEmpty: The {item} box is empty! Tap it to reorder
inc_bulkIn: A bulk order came in! Gather lots of items and deliver within 2 minutes
war_forecast: 🏷️ MegaMart price war day! Customers are price-sensitive. Earn two stars to win
chest_tap: Tap the treasure chest to open it!
help_extra_t: Bulk orders, price wars and chests
help_extra_b: From Supermarket, bulk orders sometimes arrive: lots of items in 2 minutes, so keep your shelves full (2.5x pay). While you're feuding with MegaMart, a price war day comes every 6 days: customers are price-sensitive and skip pricey shelves more often. Earn two stars to win a bonus! On two-star days you can open a treasure chest in the results; once in a while it's a jackpot. Place a claw machine near a register and customers who just paid sometimes play a round.
up_autoOrder_desc: Reorders boxes before they run out (25% extra cost)
b_beach_rule: Rule: 20% more customers, but they're impatient
b_night_rule: Rule: twice the VIPs, and twice the shoplifters
b_snow_rule: Rule: customers walk slowly on the snow, and machines break down often
land_hint2: Tap a glowing plot to buy it (next: {n}) · Your land brings +{b}% customers
